sentences.text: Mr.S.Kameswaran, learned Government Advocate takes notice on behalf of the respondents.
2. Considering the limited relief sought for in the writ petition, with the consent of the parties, the writ petition is taken up for final disposal.

3. The petitioner seeks issuance of a writ of mandamus to direct the 1st respondent to refer the petitioner's application dated 26.07.2024 seeking enhancement of land compensation to the Competent Court in terms of Section 8 of the Tamil Nadu Acquisition of Land for Industrial Purposes Act, 1997 (Tamil Nadu Act 10 of 1999).
4.

entities.text: Tamil Nadu Acquisition of Land for Industrial Purposes Act, 1997 (Tamil Nadu Act 10 of 1999)
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: I have heard the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and the learned Government Advocate appearing for the respondents.
I have also perused the materials available on record.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 5.
I find that though the award was passed on 16.08.2024, there has been an objection even prior to the passing of the order on 26.07.2024.

When the said question was put to the learned counsel for the petitioner, he submits that even during the enquiry, the Collector had informed the compensation that is proposed to be fixed for the objected lands and therefore, the petitioner has given his objections on 26.07.2024.
It is clear that the amounts to be determined was not acceptable to the petitioner.

He therefore, seeks for the said objection being treated as an objection under Section 8 of the Tamil Nadu Acquisition of Land for Industrial Purposes Act, 1997 (Tamil Nadu Act 10 of 1999).
6.

entities.text: Tamil Nadu Acquisition of Land for Industrial Purposes Act, 1997 (Tamil Nadu Act 10 of 1999)
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
I also find in the proceedings dated 06.02.2025 bearing e/f/vz;/ myF 6 m1/10/2021, the Special Tahsildar has stated that that as instructed, reference can be made to the Principal District Court,
Tirunelveli.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 7.

Considering the above, there is no legal impediment for the 1 st respondent to refer the petitioner's application dated 26.07.2024, seeking enhancement of compensation to the Principal District Court, Tirunelveli.
The said exercise shall be completed by the authorities within a period of eight (8) weeks from today.
8. The writ petition stands disposed of with the above observations and directions.
No cost.
